Privacy Policy

Who We Are

Fairmont Flooring is a flooring business based in Aberdeen, run by Sean McPherson. To reach us, call or WhatsApp 07748 146181.

What We Collect

Only what you send us: your name, your phone number, your email address if you give it, your postcode or town, and whatever you tell us about the job.

How the Quote Form Works

The quote form on this site opens WhatsApp with your details filled in. Nothing is sent until you press send in WhatsApp, and that conversation is then held by WhatsApp under its own terms.

Why We Hold It

To quote your job, to carry it out, and to keep a record of work we have done. Nothing else.

Who We Share It With

Nobody, unless a supplier needs part of it to price your flooring, and then only what they need. We do not sell data and we do not pass it to marketing companies.

How Long We Keep It

Enquiries that do not become jobs are cleared out from time to time. Records of finished work are kept longer, so a later question about a job, or the guarantee, can be answered.

Cookies

This site sets no advertising or tracking cookies. The map on the areas page loads from OpenStreetMap, so that service sees your IP address when the map loads.

Your Rights

You can ask what we hold on you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. To ask, call or WhatsApp 07748 146181.

Last updated 13 November 2026.

Herringbone, engineered wood, LVT and laminate flooring, supplied and fitted across Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.
